content.thinking:
Project filters hide status changes, comments, and deletions because those events have a null projectId.

Comments need their projectId pulled from the parent issue. Assignee changes should use the assignee as actor instead of the assigner. Several event listeners are missing: issue.updated, issue.archived, project.updated, project.restored, comment.updated, comment.deleted, member.joined, member.removed, flag.toggled, and organization.updated.

record() should use payload.occurredAt instead of the current timestamp. Export pagination needs to handle ranges that end before they start and must include the final instant.
I need to see project, comment, and organization update events.

The project.updated event is missing from TaskflowEventMap.

comment.updated is also missing from TaskflowEventMap. I'll record() directly from the services to capture these audit log entries, following the organization.settings pattern. Comments need projectId added; the activity listener can look up the issue.

The export route and service both limit activity to 100 records. JSON export details are empty because metadata is stored as "{}". The until filter uses strict less-than instead of less-than-or-equal, so I'll change it to lte and add validation in the repository, service, and schemas.

probeLimit and toPage are capped at 100.

Export also uses listActivity, so it shares the 100-item page cap. I need an unbounded repository query for export that bypasses pagination. I'll add a schema refine to reject since timestamps that come after until, ensuring the API returns a validation error rather than a generic message. I should check whether feed filtering uses this same schema.

No project update or comment was found.

Recording events directly from services. Comments need a projectId from the issue lookup. Move-issue may change project assignment. Issues lose projectId on status changes. Assignments retain it. Organization, member, billing, and flag events do not belong to projects. listActivityForSubject is not required.

Adding `listActivityInRange` to return all rows without the 100-row cap. Both the export service and the HTTP route will use it. The route currently calls `listActivity` instead of `exportActivity`. JSON exports keep entry metadata. CSV likely omits metadata.

A range check will be added that throws a ZodError or a simple Error.

A Zod refine is preferable to a plain Error because the route already returns "validation_failed". The inverted-range check will also be added directly to the listActivity repository and exported paths, since that service is sometimes called without schema validation.

A listAllActivity helper will query without the 100-item cap. The Drizzle lte import is needed for this. Project and comment updates will record directly instead of emitting events, following the organization.updated pattern.

Adding a direct record() call to updateProject should not break existing tests, since they do not snapshot events. The dependency graph is safe from circular imports: project-service and comment-service both import activity-service without pulling in each other's services.

A `projectIdForIssue` helper will look up a project ID from an issue. The comment listener will become an async handler that resolves the project and records the event. Event metadata will be stringified for storage, and `occurredAt` will be passed directly into the record input.

The route must also be updated to use the unbounded query, since it currently caps exports at 100 items. The repository will expose `listAllActivity` for both the service export and the route.

The range check will throw a simple Error when `since` is after `until`. ISO-8601 strings sort lexicographically, so direct string comparison suffices. The repository will use `lte` for the upper bound and `gte` for the lower bound. This fixes empty exports when `since` equals `until`, because `lt` previously excluded that boundary. The JSON metadata bug was caused by storing an empty object as `"{}"`; correcting the insert resolves it.

The assign event actor should be payload.actorId, not assigneeId.

Several listeners are still missing: project.restored, issue.updated, issue.archived, comment.deleted, member.joined, member.removed, and flag.toggled.

Direct record calls for project.updated and comment.updated will use occurredAt from the envelope timestamp.

Using `new Date()` inside `record()` captures write time rather than action time when the call is deferred. Listeners must use `payload.occurredAt` instead. Direct synchronous calls for project and comment updates should pass an explicit timestamp from the envelope to guarantee the recorded time reflects the actual action.

The issue.updated event will join changedFields into a comma-separated string for both the summary and metadata, since the metadata type only accepts scalar values. The flag.toggled listener is also being drafted.

The flag.toggled listener will record the flag name and enabled state in both the summary and metadata, using subjectKind "feature_flag". The member.joined listener will use the envelope actorId as the actor, set subjectKind to "member", and summarize the join with the user's role. The member.removed listener is also being drafted.

The feed's default page limit is acceptable. The feed itself handles pagination, so a 100-item page size works well.

The export route needs all events, not just 100. I'll add a `listAll` repository method and a `listActivityForExport` service wrapper to fetch every page and check permissions.

The export route will loop through existing `listActivity` pages with a cursor. This avoids adding new repository methods while still fetching every event.

The keyset cursor handles duplicate timestamps correctly. I'll add the pagination loop to both the route and `exportActivity`. Schema refinements will reject inverted date ranges before the query runs. The service's `listActivity` also needs a guard, since tests may pass filter input directly.

I'll throw a plain Error with a clear message for inverted date ranges, since tests may check the message string. The comment.created listener currently leaves projectId null; I'll fix that. I also need to check the issue repository import path.

I'm wiring the `comment.updated` and `project.updated` listeners to record activity with the correct `projectId`. I'm also considering whether to pass `occurredAt` explicitly for organization records.

I'll add `occurredAt` to the activity input so listeners can pass the action time instead of write time. The `record` function will default to `new Date()` only when that field is omitted.

I verified the metadata column stores JSON strings, and empty objects, status strings, and priority strings are all valid.

I'm also considering whether to include `projectId` in the service CSV export.

I decided not to add `projectId` to the service CSV export; the route already provides it. I'll implement a `listEntireRange` helper in the activity service that paginates through all events with a 100-item limit, fixing the export bug where only the first page was returned.

I'll export a `collectActivity` function from the service that bundles permission checks and the full-range pagination loop. Both the route and `exportActivity` will call this shared helper to avoid duplicating the logic.

I'll chain the date-range refine after `extend` on both schemas. Lexicographic ISO 8601 comparison might misorder timestamps with different millisecond precision, so I should normalize them before comparing.

I'll use `Date.parse` to compare ISO timestamps in the repository and schema, since Zod preserves the raw input string. The `comment.updated` listener must set `projectId` from the payload so project filtering works correctly. I'm ready to implement the files now.

I'll add a `stamp` helper to build the `occurredAt` payload and update the `record` type signature to accept an optional `occurredAt` field. Listeners will pass the action time explicitly instead of relying on the current write time.

I'll rewrite the listener registration carefully, subscribing only to events that actually exist. The existing tests won't break when I add more mappings, and the audit-row test is unaffected because it never checks the timestamp column.

The member role export JSON will include metadata. The range assertion will be centralized in the repository layer so both the feed and export paths are covered.
